question_text:
Can: Would you like to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ece: ----
Can: That's a pity. Maybe next time.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_a: Sure, I'll be there at five.
option_c: I'd love to, but I'm visiting my grandparents.
explanation: Can'ın “That's a pity.” (Ne yazık.) cevabı, Ece'nin daveti reddettiğini gösterir. Bahane sunarak reddeden tek seçenek “I'd love to, but I'm visiting my grandparents.”dır.

question_text: Which of the following is used to apologize?
option_a: I'm sorry for breaking your pen.
option_d: How about going to the cinema?
explanation: “I'm sorry for …” kalıbı özür dilemek için kullanılır. Diğerleri teklif, kabul ve öneri bildirir.

question_text:
Read the message.
“Hi Mert! I'm having a picnic at the park on Sunday at 11 a.m. Everyone will bring some food. Can you bring some sandwiches? Let me know. — Defne”
What does Defne want Mert to do?
option_b: Come to her house at 11 a.m.
explanation: Defne mesajında Mert'ten pikniğe sandviç getirmesini istemektedir (“Can you bring some sandwiches?”).

question_text:
Four students describe a good friend:
Ali: A good friend keeps my secrets.
Beril: A good friend always tells lies to make me happy.
Cem: A good friend supports me when I am sad.
Dila: A good friend shares things with me.
Whose idea is NOT suitable for a good friend?
explanation: İyi bir arkadaş dürüst olmalıdır. Beril'in “her zaman yalan söyler” ifadesi iyi bir arkadaşın özelliğiyle bağdaşmaz.

question_text:
Eren: Hey Zeynep, we are going bowling after school. Do you want to join us?
Zeynep: I'd really like to, but I have a piano lesson at four. ----
Eren: Sure! See you there.
Which of the following best completes the dialogue?
option_c: Can I join you after my lesson?
explanation: Zeynep önce dersi olduğunu söylemiş, Eren de “Sure! See you there.” ile olumlu cevap vermiştir. Bu nedenle Zeynep'in dersten sonra katılmayı önerdiği seçenek uygundur.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“A trustworthy friend ---- your secrets.”
explanation: Güvenilir (trustworthy) bir arkadaş sırlarını saklar (keeps your secrets).

question_text:
Look at the chart showing what students do when a friend is upset.
ActionStudents
listen to him/her18
give advice12
make him/her laugh8
leave him/her alone2
Which of the following is TRUE according to the chart?
option_a: Most students listen to their upset friend.
option_b: More students leave their friend alone than give advice.
option_c: Making a friend laugh is the most popular action.
explanation: Tabloya göre en çok öğrenci (18) üzgün arkadaşını dinlemektedir.

question_text: Sena forgot her best friend's birthday. She feels very bad about it. What should she say to her friend?
option_b: Would you like to play tennis tomorrow?
option_d: I'm really sorry I forgot your birthday. Let me make it up to you.
explanation: Sena arkadaşının doğum gününü unuttuğu için özür dilemeli ve telafi etmeyi önermelidir.

question_text:
“Why don't we go to the cinema tonight?”
Which response ACCEPTS the invitation?
explanation: “That sounds fun!” daveti kabul eder; diğer cevaplar reddetme bildirir.

question_text:
Choose the correct option.
“I can't stand ---- in long queues.”
explanation: “Can't stand” fiilinden sonra fiil -ing almalıdır: “waiting”.

question_text:
The table shows how often Emir does some activities in a week.
ActivityDays a week
play basketball7
read books3
play video games1
go to the cinema0
Which of the following is TRUE?
option_b: Emir often goes to the cinema.
explanation: Haftanın 7 günü yapılan etkinlik “always” ile anlatılır; Emir her gün basketbol oynamaktadır. Sinemaya hiç gitmez (never).

question_text:
Read the text.
“My name is Lara. I'm fourteen. I'm keen on photography and I take photos of birds at weekends. I'm not fond of shopping. I prefer spending time in nature to staying at home.”
Which of the following is NOT true about Lara?
option_d: She prefers nature to staying at home.
explanation: Lara alışverişi sevmediğini (not fond of shopping) belirtmiştir; bu nedenle alışveriş yapmaktan hoşlandığı doğru değildir.

question_text: Which frequency adverb means “0%”?
explanation: “Never” hiçbir zaman (%0) anlamındadır.

question_text:
Four teenagers talk about their weekends:
Kaan: I usually hang out with my friends at the mall.
Leyla: I rarely watch TV; I prefer reading.
Mina: I always do my homework on Saturday mornings.
Nazlı: I sometimes go cycling with my dad.
Who does an activity EVERY weekend?
explanation: “Always” her zaman anlamına gelir; Mina ödevini her cumartesi sabahı yapmaktadır.

question_text:
“She prefers tea ---- coffee.”
Which word completes the sentence?
explanation: “Prefer A to B” kalıbında “to” kullanılır: She prefers tea to coffee.

question_text:
Arda: What do you do in your free time?
Berk: ----
Arda: Really? I'm keen on it, too.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_c: I'm fond of playing the guitar.
explanation: Arda boş zamanında ne yaptığını sormuş ve cevaba “Ben de buna meraklıyım.” demiştir. Bu nedenle bir hobi bildiren cevap uygundur.

question_text: Which kitchen verb means “to cook something in hot oil”?
explanation: “Fry” kızgın yağda pişirmek anlamındadır. “Boil” kaynatmak, “chop” doğramak, “peel” soymaktır.

question_text:
Read the recipe for a fruit salad.
“First, wash the fruits. Then, peel the bananas and slice them. ---- , chop the apples into small pieces. Finally, mix all the fruits and add some honey.”
Which word completes the recipe?
explanation: Tarifte “First” ve “Then”den sonra, “Finally”den önce bir sıralama sözcüğü gerekir; “After that” uygundur.

question_text:
Making tea:
1. Boil some water.
2. Put the tea leaves into the teapot.
3. ----
4. Wait for ten minutes and serve.
Which step completes the instructions?
option_b: Pour the hot water into the teapot.
explanation: Su kaynatılıp çay yaprakları demliğe konduktan sonra sıcak su demliğe dökülmelidir.

question_text:
Choose the correct passive form.
“They mix the eggs and the flour.”
option_a: The eggs and the flour were mix.
option_b: The eggs and the flour are mixed.
option_c: The eggs and the flour is mixing.
option_d: The eggs and the flour mix.
explanation: Geniş zamanda edilgen yapı “am/is/are + V3” ile kurulur: “are mixed”.

question_text:
A recipe for pancakes:
“Mix two cups of flour, one egg and a cup of milk in a bowl. Heat a pan and add a little oil. Pour some of the mixture into the pan. Cook each side for two minutes.”
According to the recipe, which of the following is NOT necessary?
explanation: Tarifte un, yumurta, süt ve yağ kullanılmaktadır; şekerden söz edilmemiştir.

question_text:
“Could you ---- the carrots, please? I need them for the cake.”
Which verb best completes the sentence?
explanation: Havuçlu kekte havuç rendelenir: “grate the carrots”.

question_text:
Chef Kerem: First, we chop the onions. Next, we fry them for three minutes. Then, we add the tomatoes and cook for ten minutes.
What does the chef do right after chopping the onions?
explanation: Şef soğanları doğradıktan hemen sonra (Next) onları üç dakika kızartır.

question_text:
Look at the table about three dishes.
DishCooking timeMethod
Menemen15 minfry
Lentil soup40 minboil
Baked potatoes50 minbake
Which of the following is TRUE?
option_b: Lentil soup is quicker than menemen.
option_c: Menemen is baked in the oven.
option_d: Baked potatoes take the longest time to cook.
explanation: En uzun pişirme süresi 50 dakika ile fırında patatestedir. Mercimek çorbası kaynatılır ve menemenden daha uzun sürer.

question_text: Which sentence is used to ask someone to wait on the phone?
explanation: “Hold on, please.” telefonda karşı tarafı beklemeye almak için kullanılır.

question_text:
Mrs. Aydın: Hello?
Ozan: Hello, this is Ozan. Can I speak to Burak, please?
Mrs. Aydın: Sorry, he isn't at home right now. ----
Ozan: Yes, please. Can you tell him to call me back?
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_b: Would you like to leave a message?
explanation: Ozan'ın “Yes, please. Can you tell him to call me back?” cevabı, kendisine mesaj bırakmak isteyip istemediğinin sorulduğunu gösterir.

question_text:
Read the phone message note.
“Message for: Elif · From: Coach Tarık · Message: Basketball practice is cancelled tomorrow. It will be on Friday at 5 p.m.”
Which of the following is TRUE?
option_a: The practice will be tomorrow at 5 p.m.
explanation: Nota göre yarınki antrenman iptal edilmiştir; antrenman cuma saat 17.00'de yapılacaktır.

question_text:
“I can't hear you very well. ----”
Which sentence completes the speech?
explanation: Karşı tarafı iyi duyamamak hattın kötü olmasıyla ilgilidir: “The line is bad.”

question_text:
Selin calls the dentist's office.
Receptionist: Good morning, Smile Dental Clinic. How can I help you?
Selin: ----
Receptionist: Let me check. We have an appointment on Tuesday at 3 p.m.
Which of the following best completes the dialogue?
option_a: Can I speak to my teacher?
option_b: I'm calling to cancel my flight.
option_c: I'd like to make an appointment, please.
option_d: I'd like to order a pizza.
explanation: Resepsiyon görevlisinin randevu saatini söylemesi, Selin'in randevu almak istediğini gösterir.

question_text: Which question is asked to learn who the caller is?
explanation: “Who's calling, please?” arayan kişinin kim olduğunu öğrenmek için sorulur.

question_text:
Gizem: Hi Ali, are you free tonight?
Ali: Sorry, I'm going to help my mom with the cleaning. I'll call you back later, okay?
Gizem: OK, talk to you later.
What is Ali going to do tonight?
explanation: Ali bu akşam annesine temizlikte yardım edeceğini söylemiştir.

question_text:
Four people describe a phone call problem:
Ahmet: I called my friend many times, but I heard a beep every time. Someone else was talking to her.
Belgin: My phone's battery died in the middle of the call.
Can: I dialled the wrong number by mistake.
Deniz: There was a lot of noise and the voice was breaking up.
Who had a problem because “the line was busy”?
explanation: Ahmet'in aradığı kişi başka biriyle konuştuğu için hat meşguldür (the line was busy).

question_text: Which of the following is a safe online behaviour?
option_c: Using a strong password with letters and numbers
explanation: Harf ve rakam içeren güçlü bir şifre kullanmak güvenli bir internet davranışıdır.

question_text:
Emre: I want to buy a new book online, but I don't have an account.
Aysu: ----
Emre: Good idea. Thanks!
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_d: Why don't you sign up on the website?
explanation: Emre'nin hesabı yoktur; siteye üye olmasını (sign up) öneren cevap uygundur.

question_text: “To ---- a file” means to copy it from the Internet to your computer.
explanation: İnternetten bilgisayara dosya indirmek “download” ile ifade edilir.

question_text:
Read the online safety tips.
• Don't share personal information.
• Think before you post.
• Tell an adult if someone bothers you.
• Log out after using public computers.
Which of the following is NOT mentioned in the tips?
option_c: Telling an adult about bothering messages
explanation: İpuçlarında şifreyi her gün değiştirmekten söz edilmemektedir.

question_text: Which word means “bullying someone online”?
explanation: İnternet üzerinden zorbalık yapmaya “cyberbullying” denir.

question_text:
Kemal: I spend six hours a day online. I can't sleep well and I feel tired at school.
Which advice is the most suitable for Kemal?
option_a: You should buy a new phone.
option_b: You should limit your screen time.
option_c: You should play more online games.
explanation: Kemal'in sorunu internette çok fazla zaman geçirmesidir; ekran süresini sınırlaması önerilmelidir.

question_text:
Defne: How about video chatting with Grandma tonight?
Mert: ----
Which response REFUSES the suggestion?
option_a: I'd rather not. I have a lot of homework.
option_d: Sure, let's call her at eight.
explanation: “I'd rather not.” öneriyi kibarca reddeder ve bir neden sunar.

question_text:
Choose the correct option.
“Skydiving is ---- than canoeing.”
explanation: İki şey karşılaştırılırken comparative yapı kullanılır: “more dangerous than”.

question_text:
Look at the table about adventure sports.
SportPriceRisk
Rafting400 TLmedium
Paragliding1 500 TLhigh
Trekking100 TLlow
Which of the following is TRUE?
option_a: Rafting is more expensive than paragliding.
explanation: Trekking 100 TL ile en ucuz spordur. Yamaç paraşütü en pahalı ve en riskli olanıdır.

question_text:
Melis: Would you like to go rock climbing this weekend?
Onur: ---- It's too dangerous for me.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
explanation: Onur kaya tırmanışının kendisi için çok tehlikeli olduğunu söylemiştir; başka bir etkinliği tercih ettiğini bildiren “I'd rather go hiking.” uygundur.

question_text: Which is the superlative form of “good”?
explanation: “Good” düzensiz bir sıfattır: good → better → the best.

question_text:
Four friends describe their adventure experiences:
Ayla: Scuba diving was amazing; I saw colourful fish under the sea.
Bora: Bungee jumping was the scariest thing I've ever done.
Ceren: Camping in the forest was relaxing.
Doruk: Paragliding gave me the best view of the city.
Who did an underwater activity?
explanation: Tüplü dalış (scuba diving) su altında yapılan bir etkinliktir; Ayla deniz altında balıklar görmüştür.

question_text: “Mount Ağrı is ---- mountain in Türkiye.”
explanation: Bir şeyin bir grup içinde en yüksek olduğu anlatılırken superlative kullanılır: “the highest”.

question_text:
Kaan prefers safe activities and he doesn't have much money. Which activity should he choose according to the table?
ActivitySafetyCost
Hikingvery safecheap
Skydivingdangerousexpensive
Raftingquite safeexpensive
Bungee jumpingdangerouscheap
explanation: Kaan güvenli ve ucuz bir etkinlik istemektedir; tabloda bu iki özelliği taşıyan tek etkinlik doğa yürüyüşüdür (hiking).

question_text:
“I'd rather stay at a hotel than camp in a tent.”
What does the speaker mean?
option_a: He/She prefers staying at a hotel.
option_c: He/She has never been to a hotel.
option_d: He/She loves camping in a tent.
explanation: “I'd rather A than B” kalıbı A'yı tercih ettiğini gösterir; konuşan otelde kalmayı tercih etmektedir.

question_text:
Choose the correct option.
“---- you ever been to Pamukkale?”
explanation: “Ever” ile deneyim sorulurken Present Perfect kullanılır: “Have you ever been …?”

question_text:
Read the travel blog.
“Last summer, we visited Cappadocia. We took a hot-air balloon tour at sunrise. The view of the fairy chimneys was breathtaking. We also bought some pottery as souvenirs.”
Which of the following is NOT mentioned in the text?
explanation: Metinde balon turu, peribacaları ve hediyelik çömlekten söz edilmiştir; kaldıkları otelden bahsedilmemiştir.

question_text:
Tourist: Excuse me, how can I get to the museum?
Local: ----
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_d: Go straight and turn left at the bank.
explanation: Turist müzeye nasıl gidileceğini sormaktadır; yol tarifi veren cevap uygundur.

question_text: Which word means “a small object you buy to remember a place”?
explanation: Bir yeri hatırlamak için alınan küçük eşyaya “souvenir” (hediyelik eşya) denir.

question_text:
The table shows information about three cities.
CityFamous forBest time to visit
Antalyabeachessummer
Erzurumski resortswinter
Mardinstone housesspring
Zehra wants to go skiing. Which city should she visit and when?
explanation: Kayak merkezleriyle ünlü şehir Erzurum'dur ve en uygun ziyaret zamanı kıştır.

question_text: “I have ---- visited Ephesus. It was amazing!”
explanation: Olumlu Present Perfect cümlelerinde “zaten, çoktan” anlamında “already” kullanılır.

question_text:
A travel agent: “This hotel is next to the beach. It has a swimming pool and a kids' club. Breakfast is free, but you have to pay for dinner.”
Which of the following is TRUE about the hotel?
option_d: It is far from the beach.
explanation: Kahvaltı ücretsizdir (free); akşam yemeği ücretlidir ve otel plajın yanındadır.

question_text:
Can: Have you ever tried Turkish delight?
Anna: ----
Can: You should! It's delicious.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_c: Yes, I have. I love it.
explanation: Can'ın “You should!” (Denemelisin!) cevabı, Anna'nın lokumu daha önce hiç denemediğini gösterir.

question_text:
“You ---- touch the hot stove. It's dangerous!”
Which modal completes the sentence?
explanation: Yasak bildirmek için “mustn't” kullanılır.

question_text:
The chart shows who does the chores in Ece's family.
ChoreEceBrotherMomDad
do the laundry✓
take out the rubbish✓
water the plants✓
vacuum the carpet✓
Which of the following is TRUE?
option_b: Ece is responsible for watering the plants.
explanation: Tabloya göre bitkileri Ece sular; çamaşırı annesi yıkar, çöpü erkek kardeşi çıkarır.

question_text: “It's Sunday. You ---- get up early.” (It isn't necessary.)
explanation: Zorunlu olmadığını bildirmek için “don't have to” kullanılır.

question_text: Which chore is done in the kitchen after a meal?
explanation: Yemekten sonra masayı toplamak (clear the table) mutfakta yapılan bir iştir.

question_text:
Mom: Kerem, your room is a mess! ----
Kerem: OK, Mom. I'll do it after lunch.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_c: You don't have to clean it.
option_d: You have to tidy it up.
explanation: Anne odanın dağınık olduğunu söylemiş, Kerem de öğle yemeğinden sonra yapacağını belirtmiştir. Odayı toplaması gerektiğini bildiren cümle uygundur.

question_text:
Four teenagers talk about chores:
Buse: I love cooking, so I help my mom in the kitchen.
Can: I hate ironing, but I have to do it every week.
Duru: I don't mind dusting the furniture.
Ege: I can't stand doing the dishes.
Who does a chore although he/she doesn't like it?
explanation: Can ütü yapmaktan nefret ettiğini ama her hafta yapmak zorunda olduğunu söylemiştir.

question_text:
Rules of a summer camp:
• You must make your bed every morning.
• You mustn't use your phone after 10 p.m.
• You don't have to join the morning run.
Which of the following is TRUE according to the rules?
option_a: Campers can use their phones at midnight.
option_b: Joining the morning run is optional.
option_c: Campers mustn't join the morning run.
option_d: Making the bed is not necessary.
explanation: “You don't have to join the morning run.” sabah koşusuna katılmanın zorunlu olmadığını, yani isteğe bağlı olduğunu gösterir.

question_text:
Read Selin's weekly plan.
DayChore
Mondayfeed the fish
Wednesdaytake out the rubbish
Saturdayvacuum the carpet
What does Selin have to do on Wednesday?
explanation: Plana göre Selin çarşamba günü çöpü çıkarmak zorundadır.

question_text: Which chore is done with an iron?
explanation: Ütü (iron) ile yapılan iş giysileri ütülemektir.

question_text:
A student's science notebook:
“Question: Do plants need light to grow?
Hypothesis: Plants without light won't grow well.
Experiment: I put one plant near the window and another in a dark cupboard.
Result: After two weeks, the plant in the cupboard turned yellow.”
What was the result of the experiment?
option_a: The plant near the window died.
option_d: The plant in the dark became yellow.
explanation: Deney sonucunda karanlık dolaptaki bitki sararmıştır; bu, hipotezi destekler.

question_text: Where do scientists usually do experiments?
explanation: Bilim insanları deneylerini genellikle laboratuvarda yapar.

question_text:
Choose the correct passive form.
“The light bulb ---- by Thomas Edison's team.”
explanation: Geçmişte yapılan bir işin edilgen anlatımı “was/were + V3” ile yapılır: “was developed”.

question_text:
Read the text.
“Aziz Sancar is a Turkish scientist. He won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2015. His research showed how cells repair damaged DNA.”
Which of the following is TRUE?
option_a: He studied how cells repair DNA.
option_c: He won the Nobel Prize in Physics.
explanation: Metne göre Aziz Sancar, hücrelerin hasarlı DNA'yı nasıl onardığını araştırmış ve 2015'te Nobel Kimya Ödülü'nü kazanmıştır.

question_text:
Put the steps of a scientific experiment in the correct order.
I. Do the experiment
II. Make a hypothesis
III. Write the conclusion
IV. Observe a problem
explanation: Bilimsel süreçte önce bir problem gözlemlenir, sonra hipotez kurulur, deney yapılır ve sonuç yazılır.

question_text: Which word means “a new thing that is created for the first time”?
explanation: İlk kez yapılan yeni bir şeye “invention” (icat) denir.

question_text:
The timeline shows some important inventions.
1876 → telephone
1903 → first powered aeroplane flight
1928 → penicillin was discovered
1969 → humans landed on the Moon
Which of the following is TRUE according to the timeline?
option_a: The aeroplane flew before the telephone was invented.
option_b: The telephone was invented after the aeroplane.
option_c: Penicillin was discovered before humans landed on the Moon.
option_d: Humans landed on the Moon in 1928.
explanation: Penisilin 1928'de keşfedilmiş, Ay'a iniş 1969'da gerçekleşmiştir; penisilin daha öncedir.

question_text:
Teacher: Scientists ---- a new planet outside our solar system recently.
Which of the following completes the sentence?
explanation: “Recently” (son zamanlarda) ile yakın geçmişte gerçekleşen bir olay Present Perfect ile anlatılır: “have discovered”.

question_text:
Four students talk about technology:
Ali: Smartphones have made communication easier.
Beyza: Robots are used in hospitals for surgery.
Cem: Electric cars were invented to reduce air pollution.
Deniz: I think science is boring.
Who expresses a personal opinion rather than a fact?
explanation: Deniz'in “I think science is boring.” sözü kişisel bir görüştür; diğerleri bilgi bildirir.

question_text: What should you do during an earthquake?
explanation: Deprem sırasında “çök, kapan, tutun” (drop, cover and hold on) yapılmalıdır.

question_text:
“If people cut down more trees, there ---- more floods and landslides.”
Which of the following completes the sentence?
explanation: Gelecekle ilgili koşul–sonuç bildiren cümlelerde sonuç kısmında “will” kullanılır.

question_text:
Look at the emergency kit list.
• water bottles
• a torch
• a first-aid kit
• a whistle
• ----
Which item is the most suitable to complete the list?
explanation: Acil durum çantasında hayati önemi olan malzemeler bulunur; battaniye bu listeye en uygun olanıdır.

question_text: Which natural disaster happens when there is no rain for a long time?
explanation: Uzun süre yağmur yağmamasına bağlı afet kuraklıktır (drought).

question_text:
Read the news.
“Heavy rain caused a flood in the city yesterday. Many streets were under water, so schools were closed. Experts say the flood happened because the drains were blocked with rubbish.”
What was the main cause of the flood according to experts?
option_b: The drains were blocked with rubbish.
explanation: Uzmanlara göre selin nedeni kanalizasyonların çöple tıkanmasıdır.

question_text: “Scientists predict that the temperature ---- in the next fifty years.”
explanation: Gelecekle ilgili tahmin “will” ile ifade edilir.

question_text:
The table shows some natural disasters and safety tips.
DisasterSafety tip
WildfireLeave the area quickly.
EarthquakeDrop, cover and hold on.
FloodGo down to the basement.
Which safety tip in the table is WRONG?
explanation: Sel sırasında bodruma inmek tehlikelidir; yüksek bir yere çıkılmalıdır. Bu nedenle sel için verilen ipucu yanlıştır.

question_text:
Mert: We should use less plastic. ----
Which sentence gives a reason for Mert's idea?
option_c: I bought a new bag yesterday.
option_d: It pollutes the oceans and harms animals.
explanation: Plastiğin okyanusları kirletmesi ve hayvanlara zarar vermesi, daha az plastik kullanılması gerektiğinin nedenidir.
